title: seampact IR: common members
description: Ids, names, origins, docs and extension slots shared by every IR file (ADR 0004 sections 3 and 6).

SchemaId.description: The id of a named schema: its catalogue key, the name as written or the canonical identifier of a derived name (ADR 0004 section 9, ADR 0002 section 4, ADR 0007).

ScalarId.description: The id of a named format: its catalogue key (ADR 0003 section 8, ADR 0002 section 4).

EnumId.description: The id of an enum: its catalogue key, the name as written or the canonical identifier of a derived name (ADR 0004 section 9, ADR 0002 section 4).

ErrorCode.description: An error code, the key of the errors catalogue (ADR 0004 section 4, ADR 0002 section 4).

NatureId.description: The id of a contract nature: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9, ADR 0002 section 4).

SchemeId.description: The id of a security scheme: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9, ADR 0002 section 4).

HeaderId.description: The id of an identity header: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9, ADR 0002 section 4).

IdentityId.description: The id of an identity: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9, ADR 0002 section 4).

RightId.description: The id of a right: its catalogue key, the name its library uses, without line breaks or leading or trailing space (ADR 0002 section 4).

RuleId.description: The id of a rule: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9, ADR 0002 section 4).

ScopeId.description: The id of a scope: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9, ADR 0002 section 4).

BucketId.description: The id of a rate-limit bucket: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9, ADR 0002 section 4).

ServiceId.description: The id of a service: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9, ADR 0002 section 4).

ExtensionKeyId.description: A declared extension key, written '<prefix>-<key>' (ADR 0002 sections 4 and 12).

ExtensionPrefix.description: An extension prefix (ADR 0002 section 4); the compiler refuses 'seampact', which is reserved.

ExtensionKey.description: An extension key under its prefix (ADR 0002 section 4).

FormatId.description: The id of a wire format: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9, ADR 0002 section 4).

PagingId.description: The id of a paging style: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9, ADR 0002 section 4).

SurfaceId.description: The id of an api surface: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9, ADR 0002 section 4).

DocumentId.description: The id of an api document: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9, ADR 0002 section 4).

VariantId.description: The id of a principal variant: its catalogue key (ADR 0004 section 9).

DerivationId.description: A derivation id of the derivation table (ADR 0006 section 5), 'pack.<pack>.<entry>' for a pack entry.

Feature.description: A must-understand feature name (ADR 0005 section 3); none is defined at irRevision 1.

Reason.description: The written reason of an exception: non-empty, without leading or trailing white space (A36, ADR 0002 section 4).

SchemaRef.description: A reference by id to a named object schema of the schemas catalogue (ADR 0004 section 4).

NameRole.description: The role of a name (ADR 0007 section 1).

Name.description: A canonical name: word segments plus a role, never a final identifier (ADR 0007 section 1 and its amendment).

status.description: The HTTP success or redirect status of a 'response' name; present if and only if role is 'response' (invariant ir.name.status, ADR 0004 section 13).

additionalProperties.description: A consumer value, kept as raw JSON.

Origin.description: Where an element was declared: a JSON Pointer into the merged authoring tree of its layer (ADR 0004 section 6).

api.description: Set on an element copied from another api by a relay route.

layer.description: 'api', 'shared', 'base', 'pack:<name>', or 'workspace' for a diagnostic on workspace.yaml (no IR element carries it). Closed: the one exception to open enums (ADR 0004 section 13).

DerivedFrom.description: Present on, and only on, an element the compiler derived (ADR 0004 section 6).

ValueSourceIn.description: Where a value is read (ADR 0002 section 4); 'resolver' only as a scope source, 'holderField' only as a field right's subject source.

ValueSource.description: Where a value is read (ADR 0004 section 7). 'name' with path, query, header, body, principal, scope and holderField (the holder's property); no other member with host, subdomain and resolver; 'prefixBits' only with address (invariants ir.value-source.members and ir.value-source.place).
